conf.description: Building Automation (Niagara) operator-audit api-pull direct route: oBIX/BQL collector JSON row parse, ECS rename and history/security-text extraction, no vendor pack/integration exists

conf.comment: Niagara AuditHistory/SecurityHistory rows pulled via oBIX History query or scheduled BQL query. Assumes the Collector delivers one JSON/NDJSON row per _raw (BQL path); oBIX XML obj documents are NOT handled here (see README gap). No vendor pack/integration exists.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, transport assumption and known gap
Extract the BQL/NDJSON audit row into top-level fields
Best-effort extraction of auth scheme, client address and login result from the SecurityHistory record value text; only matches log-in/log-out rows
Custom bas.niagara.* namespace copies plus derived event.outcome/source.ip; historyOrd assumed pre-tagged per-job by the collector (see README gap), not a field the query itself returns
Batch rename of the directly-mapped columns
Event time from the oBIX/BQL abstime, which carries a full instant with time zone (platform constraint: never target @timestamp)
Set event.dataset (no hyphen) and drop staging fields consumed into their ECS/custom targets above
